text:
maria_cust: file_search tool.call returns 400 invalid JSON when I include a templated path in args. Works if I remove the template. Repro below.

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/toolcalls' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{tool: file_search, args: "{path: /home/alice/project/${ENV}/logs/app.log, query: TODO: fix, recursive: true,}"}'
```

alex_support: Looks like args is a string containing JSON that has a trailing comma right before the final }. Inner JSON parse fails. If you pass args as an object (not a string) it should work. Example:

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/toolcalls' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{tool: file_search, args: {path: /home/alice/project/${ENV}/logs/app.log, query: TODO: fix, recursive: true}}'
```

alex_support: Can you send the request_id from the failing call? Also which SDK version are you using?

maria_cust: request_id=rc_20240305_abc123, using redwood-js 0.4.2. We reproduce with curl too.

sam_sre: redwood-js 0.4.2 had a codepath that stringifies args for compatibility — will check. @lena_eng can you look at parsing logs for rc_20240305_abc123?

lena_eng: saw the failure in parsing-service: JSON parse error: Trailing comma at position 123 — confirming inner JSON trailing comma. Root cause: sdk sent args as stringified JSON with extra trailing comma introduced by app code that builds the payload with a template. Plan: push SDK patch to avoid auto-stringifying args and add validation.

alex_support: For a quick workaround, remove the trailing comma or pass args as an object. Also upgrade to redwood-js 0.5.0 once published.

maria_cust: Upgraded to 0.5.0 and switched to object args — fixed, calls succeed. Thanks!

sam_sre: created GH issue redwood/redwood-js#432 with repro and assigned to @lena_eng.
